findings.title: Prefix and suffix diff stripping can overlap and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: When computing the difference between `value` and `sanitized` for the error message, `start` and `end` are incremented independently without ensuring `start + end <= Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length())`. If one string is a prefix/suffix of the other with repeated characters around the difference (for example, `value` is `"<b><b>"` and `sanitized` is `"<b>"`), `start` reaches 3 and `end` reaches 3, causing `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` to call `substring(3, 0)` and throw `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException`. The second loop condition should also require `start + end < sanitized.length() && start + end < value.length()`.

findings.title: ANCHOR_PATTERN matches any tag starting with 'a', not just <a> tags
findings.body: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` is defined as `Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>")`. Because there is no word boundary or whitespace/closing-bracket check after `a`, this regex also matches other HTML tags whose names begin with `a`, such as `<abbr>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<audio>`, or `<applet>`. A translation containing `<applet>` or `<audio>` will be treated as an anchor tag in `santizeAnchors` rather than being evaluated by the HTML sanitizer policy. The pattern should require `>` or whitespace after `a` (e.g., `</?a(?:\s[^>]*)?>`).

findings.title: i18next message replaced with Java MessageFormat syntax in account-ui and admin-ui bundles
findings.body: In `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties` (and `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties` line 3138), `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. The `account-ui` and `admin-ui` apps use i18next on the frontend, which expects `{{0}}` interpolation placeholders (like all other keys in these two files) and does not support Java `MessageFormat` `{2,choice,...}` syntax. When rendered through i18next, the placeholders and choice pattern will be displayed literally without substitution.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: In the Lithuanian localization files `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties` (line 101, `totpStep1`) and `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties` (line 71, `loginTotpStep1`), the Lithuanian text was replaced with Italian: `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`.
